## Agarican, Amanite (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
LN Medium plant (fungus)  
**Init** +5; **Senses** low-light vision, darkvision 120 ft.; Perception +19  


**Defense**


**AC** 23, touch 17, flat-footed 16 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 natural, +1 shield)  
**hp** 168 (14d8+56)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +8, **Will** +5  
**DR** 10/cold iron; **Immune** plant traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** 2 +1 rainbow chitin shortswords +14/+14/+9/+9 (1d6+4 plus poison), 2 tentacles +16 (1d4+5 plus poison)  
**Special Attacks** sneak attack +2d6  
**Spell-like Abilities** (CL 9th; concentration +11)  


At will—dancing darkness, dimension door (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only, 1d4 rounds between uses) flare (DC 12)  

3/day—accelerate poison (DC 14), mirror image, vine strike (DC 14)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 17, **Dex** 21, **Con** 18, **Int** 15, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +20, **CMD** 34  
**Feats** Combat Expertise, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting, Two-Weapon Defense, Two-Weapon Feint, Two-Weapon Fighting, Polynoxious (Dex to Con), Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Bluff +14, Perception +19, Survival +16, Stealth +22  
**Languages** Agaric, Sylvan, Undercommon  


**Special Abilities**


**Envenom (Ex)** An amanite can coat any weapons that they may be wielding with their tentacle poison as a swift action.  

**Freeze (Ex)** An amanite can hold itself so still that it appears to be a large, inanimate mushroom. An amanite that uses freeze can take 20 on its Stealth check to hide in plain sight as a giant mushroom, which may or may not be a suitable disguise depending on the surroundings.  

**Poison (Ex)** Tentacle—injury; *save* Fort DC 21; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d3 Dex, 1 Str; *cure* 1 save. Save DC is Con-based.  


**About**


**Environment** temperate forests or swamps  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or ring (3-9)  
**Treasure** standard (mostly gear)
